# HYST — Zero Commission Food Ordering Platform UK

> HYST (https://hyst.uk) is the UK's leading zero-commission online food ordering platform for restaurants and takeaway businesses.

## Overview
HYST enables restaurants across the United Kingdom to offer direct online ordering to their customers at genuine menu prices without paying 20-35% commission fees to third-party marketplaces.

## Core Features & Offerings
- **Direct Online Ordering**: Custom ordering system for takeaway, delivery, and collection.
- **Zero Commission Model**: Restaurants keep 100% of their meal earnings.
- **QR Code Table Ordering**: Seamless in-restaurant dining & contactless ordering.
- **Restaurant Loyalty Programmes**: Integrated rewards, customer retention & automated discount coupons.
- **POS & Payment Integrations**: Works with major payment processors and EPOS hardware.
- **Uber Direct Delivery Integration**: Automated local driver dispatch and delivery tracking.
